enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe deeply. Remain still. Occasional eye movement. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Pack wallet. Pack keys. Pick up phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at work. Clock in. Review patient list. Walk to first patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record data. Walk to next patient. Administer medication. Update records. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient cases. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Talk to patient. Assist doctor.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Take out pan. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Wipe table. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Browse internet. Check email. Watch video. Adjust desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Use bathroom. Return to bedroom. Sit at desk. Continue using computer. Turn off computer. Stand up.
Walk to bedroom. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on bed. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Lie down on bed. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Close eyes.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up face wash. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Watch video. Type message. Send message. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down in bed. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Twitch leg. Move arm. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.
